media: SELECT medium_id, kind, is_backup, location_hint, last_scanned,       file_count, byte_count, only_here_count, only_here_bytes,       durability, lease_expires FROM media ORDER BY medium_id
summary: SELECT content_count, content_bytes, instance_count FROM catalog_summary WHERE id=1
media_count: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM media
resolve_by_path: SELECT hash FROM instances WHERE path=? LIMIT 1
resolve_by_name: SELECT DISTINCT hash FROM instances WHERE name=? LIMIT 2
content_size: SELECT size FROM content WHERE hash=?
placements: SELECT i.medium_id, m.kind, m.is_backup, i.path, i.seen_at,       m.location_hint FROM instances i JOIN media m ON m.medium_id=i.medium_id WHERE i.hash=? ORDER BY m.is_backup DESC, i.medium_id
redundancy_rows: SELECT hash, size, backup_copies, copies, example_path FROM content WHERE backup_copies < ? ORDER BY backup_copies, size DESC LIMIT ?
redundancy_total: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(content_count), 0) AS n FROM backup_histogram WHERE backup_copies < ?
only_on_rows: SELECT path, size FROM instances WHERE medium_id=? AND only_here=1 ORDER BY size DESC LIMIT ?
only_on_totals: SELECT only_here_count, only_here_bytes FROM media WHERE medium_id=?
newest_scan: SELECT MAX(last_scanned) AS newest FROM media
